description: Gares de Bourgogne-Franche-Comté is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DREAL Bourgogne-Franche-Comté. Railway stations in the region currently in use. Coverage: DREAL Bourgogne-Franche-Comté. The publisher named on the listing is DREAL Bourgogne-Franche-Comté. Its keywords include ter, ferroviaire, train, gares, trafic, transport-collectif. The listing shows 1 download or service links in SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
